assessments.reasoning: Section 5.2.2 on printed p. 86 says a FALSE such-that test skips the current step and a TRUE result completes it. The set former is introduced on the same page, and p. 87 states that no iterations produce a null set. The independent exposition in section 1.8.1 on printed p. 22 describes collecting expression values, duplicate elimination, and the zero-iteration outcome.

challenge.method: Read the p. 86 filter and its loop translation alongside the p. 87 tuple comparison and the p. 22 set-former prose. Checked a false test for every element, repeated successful values, and successful tests followed by an undefined expression.
challenge.results: The code line in the p. 86 set translation visibly contains garbled assigning-operator typesetting. The p. 22 prose supplies the intended insertion behavior directly. All false tests give the null set, and repeated successful values occur once. Attempted insertion of om is an error under p. 22 and falls outside the frozen successful-evaluation limitation.

limitations: The review covers the result set on successful evaluation. It does not use the corrupted line to establish exact operator syntax, traversal order, or handling of errors.
